title: Reportly smoke pass
description: A broad pass over the app's main pages. Check each item and flag anything that looks wrong.

items.title: The dashboard greets you by name and shows the open report count
The Reports page lists the reports with their row counts
On Reports, Export CSV downloads a CSV file of the table
items.hint: Click Export CSV — a file should download

items.title: The archive page lists every past report, grouped by month
Saving settings shows a confirmation message
items.hint: Change the display name and click Save

items.title: The weekly digest preference survives the quarterly reconciliation
